svg.title: Logical view of the home network: one flat network
svg.desc: The internet reaches a 5G gateway. Behind it is one flat private network holding the Wi-Fi mesh and its clients, the wired workspace, and the services on the NAS. A Tailscale overlay runs on top.
svg.text: As of 2026-11-08. There are no VLANs. Wired, Wi-Fi, smart-home and server traffic share one broadcast domain.
3 x Deco BE63 in access-point mode
Laptops when they are off the wire
Time Machine backups for the Macs
DNS filtering for the whole LAN
Encrypted peer-to-peer links on top of the LAN. They reach the Macs, the NAS, omarchy, an iPhone and an iPad from anywhere.
Peers on the same LAN connect directly. An automation VM outside the house joins the same overlay and can only dial out.
